source_differences: The US page gives 8 inches (203.2 mm), while the Australian table uses the nominal 200 mm / 8-inch description. These are retained separately.
The US opening is 1.125 inches (28.575 mm), feature prose rounds this to 29 mm, and the Australian row gives 28.5 mm. The inch specification is selected; no extra 0.425 mm travel is silently added.

Overall width 0.656 inch (16.6624 mm), overall height 2.5 inches (63.5 mm), jaw width 2.48 inches (62.992 mm) and jaw thickness 0.30 inch (7.62 mm) describe different quantities. The page does not identify the jaw state or measurement datums of its overall envelope.
